title: EPIGRAPHIC MONUMENTS IN THE ARCHITECTURE OF KHIVA: THE INSCRIPTIONS OF THE QAZI KALON MADRASAH
description: This article analyzes the inscriptions, ornamental patterns, and architectural features of the Qazi Kalon Madrasah in Khiva. Particular attention is paid to the epigraphic inscriptions found on the architectural elements of the monument, their decorative characteristics, and their historical and cultural significance. The study examines how inscriptions and ornamental designs contribute to understanding the architectural heritage and cultural traditions of Khiva.
